title: Microburst queue amplification harness for continuous-batching runtime
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Intermittent microbursts in production traffic appear to unlock adverse interactions between continuous batching and queueing logic, producing amplified p95/p99 spikes even when average tokens/sec stays within SLOs. This ticket creates a reproducible harness that quantifies the amplification effect across model sizes, sequence lengths, and concurrency profiles so the runtime team can design mitigations (early-flush heuristics, dynamic batch caps, or routing to low-latency nodes).

Scope: synthetic and semi-synthetic workloads that combine steady background load with periodic microbursts, measurement of internal queue length, batch composition, KV cache hit-rate, and end-to-end latency. The harness should support parameterized experiments (burst amplitude, burst duration, inter-arrival distribution, mix of short/long contexts), produce CSV/Parquet outputs for analysis, and integrate with existing benchmarking infra. Must be runnable in CI with limited scale and in a cloud testbed for broader experiments.

Non-goals: full A/B rollout for mitigation policies (separate follow-up), persistence of long-term results in analytics DB (we will upload summarized artifacts).
approach: Implement a traffic generator that composes: a steady Poisson background at target tokens/sec and configurable microburst events (gamma-distributed inter-burst intervals, adjustable burst magnitude and duration)
Instrument the runtime to emit per-request metadata: enqueue timestamp, dequeue timestamp, batch_id, batch_size, model_variant, kv_cache_hit (when applicable)
Collect end-to-end metrics: tokens/sec, requests/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, queue length distribution, batch size histogram, per-batch latency breakdown (serialization, kernel, postprocessing)

Run factorial experiments across variables: concurrency (1-128), sequence length mix (10/64/512), model variants (fp16/4-bit quantized), and burst profiles; automate via experiment YAMLs and scheduler

Add regression detection: baseline runs to compute control quantiles, and an automated delta check (p95 increase > 15% AND absolute increase > 15ms) that flags regressions and attaches artifacts to a GitHub issue
Visualize each run in a Grafana dashboard and export result summaries (CSV + compressed traces) to the artifacts bucket
measurements: Queue length CDF and time-series during bursts
Batch size distribution and time-correlated batch composition
KV cache hit rate and its correlation with latency changes
Throughput vs concurrency curve and identification of knee points
Regression signal: relative and absolute p95 deltas compared against baseline runs
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs reproducibly in local CI mode (scaled-down parameters) and in the cloud testbed with identical config files
Artifacts generated for each experiment: CSV summary, per-request trace (compressed), and Grafana snapshot link
Automated regression detector correctly flags two intentionally injected regressions in a controlled test (documented in comments)
Results for 3 model variants and 3 burst profiles are present in the artifacts bucket for review
A short doc (Confluence) documents how to add new model variants or burst profiles and how to interpret the dashboard
comments: 2025-02-12 Ava Martinez: Created ticket after on-call incident where p95 spikes correlated with short client-side retries. Initial hypothesis: microburst plus continuous batching increases queue consolidation and yields larger batches with higher kernel scheduling variance.

2025-02-17 PM review (Lena Cho): Please include cost-per-token estimates for burst mitigation strategies so PM can weigh tradeoffs. Added to measurements list.
2025-02-19 SRE (Marco Li): Suggested adding tail-sample capture (sample 1% of requests) to reduce artifact volume for long runs. Implemented in generator; added flag --tail-sample=0.01.

2025-02-20 Ravi Kapoor: Ran controlled regression test—introduced artificial 20% serialization delay and verified detector flagged run. Preparing follow-up PR to integrate detector into nightly pipeline. Pending review.
